FoodShiner is a food inventory app that will help you to keep track of all your food supplies in a simple and elegant way.

We believe that food management is very private, after all, the complete consumption of an individual / a family is understandable. Therefore, all data is only stored on your device or, if you wish, in iCloud. There are no registration options, we have no access to your data, we do not create any profiles, we do not receive any metadata, not even statistics on the use of the app and feature usage runs within the app.

-----------------

Features include:

- Unlimited number of lists to organize your products the way you want.
- iCloud sync to keep your data-up-to-date between all your devices.
- iCloud sharing so that you can share your lists with family members, friends ...
- SmartLists gives you quick overview of products soon to be expired, items you have already opened, already expired ... 
- Quickly add products just by scanning the barcode.
- Notification for each product approaching expiration date.
- Custom product categories.
- Achievements, food waste score.
- Ability to view all the history of consumed / thrown products.
- Full iPadOs support that include slide over, split view, trackpad, context menus and keyboard shortcuts.
- Dark mode support.
- Secure the application with FaceId or TouchId.
- Make backups from in-app settings, backups can be accessed from the Files app.

FoodShiner is free to use.
